name: Hermes Desktop
description: Vendored source mirror of the native desktop app for Hermes Agent (Nous Research).

source.commitSubject: fix(agent): side-question review fixes (unattended turns, profile-bound leases, billing, attribution)

app.stage: public preview (shipped 2026-06-02 with Hermes Agent v0.15.2; GA surface in v0.16.0)
app.backend: headless `hermes serve` process exposing the tui_gateway JSON-RPC/WebSocket API

excludedFromMirror.reason: Agent runtime, gateway, skills and Python tooling make up the majority of the upstream monorepo (~233 MB working tree, 21k files). They are not needed to build, run or modify the desktop shell, and are installed by the official Hermes installer at runtime.

localAdaptations.change: Root workspace manifest rewritten for the trimmed monorepo: workspaces are `apps/*` + `tests-js` (dropped `web`, `ui-tui`), web/tui scripts and the lefthook `prepare` hook removed, devDependencies trimmed to what the desktop lint/typecheck needs.
localAdaptations.reason: The dropped workspaces are not vendored, so the upstream manifest (and its 708 KB lockfile) cannot install.
Upstream lockfile resolves workspaces that do not exist here.

localAdaptations.change: Upstream file verbatim, plus a short appended block for mirror-local artifacts (`.upstream/`, `*.tsbuildinfo`).
localAdaptations.reason: Keeps upstream ignore semantics while covering local tooling.

localAdaptations.change: Replaced the 14-byte placeholder with mirror documentation.
localAdaptations.reason: This repository is a mirror, not the upstream project; readers need provenance and setup first.

localAdaptations.change: Added. No upstream source file is modified.
localAdaptations.reason: Attribution, MIT compliance, and reproducible re-sync.
